title: Go ice fishing from a heated cabin
description: Step onto a frozen Fairbanks-area lake with a guide, lower a line through the ice, and watch for the first small movement below. Rod’s Alaskan Guide Service pairs the fishing with a heated cabin, so you can warm your hands and learn the technique without spending the entire outing outside. Evening trips also leave room to look up for the aurora.
teaser: Try ice fishing with a warm cabin nearby.
goodToKnow: Winter outings are commonly offered from November into early April. The catch and any aurora sighting will depend on conditions.
whyItMightDelightYou: A quiet patch of lake becomes absorbing once you are waiting for a fish beneath your feet.
